mentions.name: Godot 3v3 bomb defusal shooter
mentions.description: A 3v3 bomb defusal shooter built in Godot, inspired by Rainbow 6 Siege but on smaller maps for quicker-paced matches. Gameplay centers on intel and gadgets: teams try to make the other side waste their gadgets so matches come down to a gun-versus-gun fight.
mentions.problem: Rainbow 6 Siege X will never support Linux due to a lack of kernel-level anti-cheat support, and streaming from a Windows PC via NVIDIA Shield is not the same as playing natively with friends.
mentions.audience: The author and their friends who play casual 3v3 matches, wanting a game they can play natively on Linux.
mentions.source_excerpt:
My goal is not to make an exact clone, but to make a smaller map version for 3v3 that is a bit more quick paced.

For context, it's a bomb defusal game where the main goal is intel and gadgets. You need to make the other side waste their gadgets so it comes down to a gun v gun fight.
